site_brief.title: Super for recruiters sourcing candidates and coordinating interviews

summary: A conversion‑focused niche landing page for recruiters who spend their days sourcing candidates, chasing responses, and coordinating interviews across dozens of tools. Grounded in current recruiting and agentic‑AI market evidence, the page positions Super as the sharper alternative for durable, repeatable recruiting workflows — a personal AI agent that actually operates computers and reuses a computer-use cache so sourcing and scheduling get faster and cheaper over time.
